items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: In fact when the old man was late some days, the kid would give him a lesson.

ctx.x: I guess he doesn't play music. No, no, he hasn't played music.

He's practicing in some country town I understand. He was an admitting surgeon at a charity for quite a while after his internship. But the guy could play clarinet, gee, I mean legitimate clarinet, you know. He was sensational. In fact when the old man was late some days, the kid would give him a lesson. He was a good guy.
That's how good he was. When did you take up other instruments?
